title: 厄加特·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 装甲躯干配呼吸面罩与厚重肩部，下方六条机械蟹腿数量清楚。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Urgot is a fictional cyborg whose lower body is a SIX-LEGGED MECHANICAL HEXAPOD chassis with three pairs of crablike walking legs, each ending in a separate ground-contact foot. A broad adult armored upper torso with a bald masked head and heavy green-and-steel shoulder armor rises from this base. He has TWO upper-body ARMS in addition to the SIX lower walking legs: one large closed covered cylindrical mechanical arm and one gloved mechanical hand. Preserve his adult face, breathing mask, heavy industrial silhouette and fully enclosed armor. The hexapod base has six walking legs, not four; the two upper arms do not count as support legs.
art_direction.scene: True 90-degree overhead view. Compact adult torso looking up in the central third; six separate mechanical support legs spread in three paired rows toward upper-left/upper-right, directly left/right, lower-left/lower-right. All six complete leg paths, sockets and grounded feet visible with pale-paper gaps. Two separate compact upper arms stay close to the torso. Bright green-white industrial armor, graphite contours, colored-pencil cross-hatching and paper grain.
art_direction.palette: iron gray, green, rust, white light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
art_direction.prompt_variant: Focused per-champion overhead refinement of the archived shared bright-sketch art direction

visual_qa.method: Single compressed JPEG preview, 1024 px max edge and under 350 KB; all six sockets, leg paths and feet counted
